answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake, then randomly audit transactions against signed delivery receipts and counterparties’ confirmations. If an audit finds fabricated work, the stake is slashed and the identity loses access. A sybil attacker must lock up capital for every persona and risk losing it, so scaling fake accounts is costly even when they create an ocean of activity. A falcon on a ledge gets no special exemption.
